name: Permanent Residence Permit

requirements.blocker_text: Historically required 8 years of continuous residence in Montserrat immediately preceding application, per reporting on the governing subsidiary regulations; not independently confirmed against the regulation text itself in this pass.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 8 years of continuous residence in Montserrat.

requirements.blocker_text: Historically required proof of an average monthly savings account balance of at least EC$5,000 during the 6 months immediately preceding application, alongside gainful employment in that period, medical clearance, and police character certificates. A temporary policy in effect from 2019 to 1 June 2020 waived this savings requirement for non-nationals resident 12+ years, on economic/humanitarian grounds; it is not confirmed whether that waiver was ever made permanent.

evidence_required.document: Bank statements showing required average savings balance
Proof of gainful employment in the preceding 6 months
Medical clearance and police character certificate

sources.title: Montserrat Chapter 13.01, Immigration Act -- Section 19 (Governor in Council may grant a permit of permanent residence or economic residence 'subject to such conditions as he may think fit'; references subsidiary Immigration (Permanent Residence Permits) Regulations, S.R.O. 66/2005), Section 20 (revocation grounds: 3+ years' absence, criminal imprisonment, conduct contrary to public interest, spousal separation/dissolution)

Discover MNI (Montserrat news outlet) -- reporting on the 8-year residence and EC$5,000 average-savings requirements for Permanent Residence, and a temporary 2019-2020 policy waiving the savings requirement for 12+ year residents

notes: STATUS: DRAFT, part of Montserrat's initial build. The Immigration Act's Section 19 itself states no financial or residence criteria -- it grants the Governor in Council open discretion. The actual numeric criteria (8 years' residence, EC$5,000 average savings balance) live in the referenced Immigration (Permanent Residence Permits) Regulations, S.R.O. 66/2005, whose full text was not located at tier-1 in this pass despite a dedicated search; the figures here are sourced instead from a Montserrat news outlet's reporting on a 2019 Cabinet policy change, which is why this route is marked draft rather than published. The 2019 savings-requirement waiver for 12+ year residents was explicitly time-limited to 1 June 2020; whether it was extended or made permanent afterward is not confirmed, so the standing 8-year/EC$5,000 rule is modelled as the current baseline, not the temporary waiver. Revocation grounds (Section 20) are tier-1 confirmed and apply regardless of this draft flag. This route is distinct from the property-based ms_resident_permit_property_owner.json (a lighter, immediately-available status) and from ms_economic_residence.json (a Section 19 sibling permit for investors).
